entries.title: 新媒体运营起步套装：热点 → 文案 → 分发一条龙
entries.titleEn: Social Media Starter Kit: trends → copy → publish in one flow
entries.text: 装上这 4 个：TrendRadar 自动盯全网热点、电商视觉文案 Skill 出商品图文案、rayskills 把内容直接排进公众号/X 草稿箱、微信 OpenClaw 通道让 WorkBuddy 直连微信。从选题到发布，每天省 2 小时。
entries.textEn: Install these 4: TrendRadar watches all-platform hot topics, the e-commerce copywriting Skill produces product copy, rayskills pipes drafts straight into WeChat/X, and the OpenClaw WeChat channel connects WorkBuddy to WeChat. Save 2 hours a day from ideation to publish.

entries.title: 开发者效率三件套：让 agent 真正读懂你的代码库
entries.titleEn: Developer Trio: make your agent actually understand the codebase
entries.text: Serena 提供语义级代码检索编辑，codebase-memory-mcp 把代码库索引成持久知识图谱，context-mode 再把工具输出压缩 98%。三者叠加，长会话不爆上下文、agent 改代码不再瞎猜。
entries.textEn: Serena adds semantic code retrieval/editing, codebase-memory-mcp indexes your repo into a persistent knowledge graph, and context-mode compresses tool output by 98%. Together: no context blowups, no more guessing.

entries.title: 设计产出套装：从原型到落地页，全给 agent 装上
entries.titleEn: Design Output Kit: prototypes to landing pages for your agent
entries.text: open-design 把 agent 变成设计引擎（原型/看板/幻灯片导出真实文件），ui-ux-pro-max-skill 提供配色/字体/布局知识库，CodeDrobe Skills 负责给桌面应用换肤。设计师的活，AI 也能出一版。
entries.textEn: open-design turns the agent into a design engine (real HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 exports), ui-ux-pro-max-skill adds palette/typography/layout knowledge, CodeDrobe Skills themes desktop apps. A credible AI first pass on design work.
